body:
F3 IS DISCHARGED AT 3c194f59c4 AND IT WENT FURTHER THAN THE FINDING ASKED. Requesting your verdict. Builds are re-running; I am routing now rather than after, because there are two things in here I want you looking at hardest and neither is the four sites.

VERIFIED BY ME IN THE TREE BEFORE ROUTING:

    ci_probe_via_forge( calls remaining   ZERO
    ci_probe_with_forge( calls            8

FIVE SITES, NOT FOUR. The lane converted the four we enumerated and found a fifth while doing it — `drain_cmd.rs probe_resume_facts` (ci_green), in a function that already takes project_root and uses it for the branch-origin probe immediately above and the verdict path immediately below. That one was not in your finding or my relay of it.

ONE DECISION PER SITE, IN THE COMMIT MESSAGE, as asked. Including the one partial:
`watch_ci_terminal`'s None arm KEEPS cwd discovery, with the reason stated — in that arm no
caller root exists to prefer. That is the "a site deliberately left is fine; a site silently
left is what produced this round" contract being honoured rather than quoted.

THE TWO THINGS WORTH YOUR SCRUTINY:

1. IT REMOVED THE FUNCTIONS RATHER THAN LEAVING THEM CALLERLESS. `ci_probe_via_forge` and
   `probe_ci_state_for_branch` are deleted, with the reasoning: "Their whole purpose was cwd
   resolution, so leaving them in the tree is the entry point a future call site would reach
   for." I think that is right and it is the difference between fixing five sites and closing
   the class — but it is ALSO the largest blast radius in the change, and a deletion is the
   kind of thing that looks clean in a diff and breaks a caller nobody grepped for.
   `probe_ci_state_for_branch_github` is explicitly kept because GitHubForge still calls it.

2. THE FIFTH SITE WAS SELF-REPORTED. Nothing in the finding would have caught it if the lane
   had stayed literal. That is the behaviour we want, and it is also the one case where I have
   no independent enumeration to check the work against — my grep confirms zero remain, which
   proves completeness of the CLASS but not that the fifth conversion is CORRECT.

NO SPEC TRAILER, deliberately, and the commit says why: this does not discharge TASK-1273's
acceptance. Correct — and the acceptance it does not discharge is now on TASK-1425, not on
TASK-1273. TASK-1273's closure criterion was repointed to F3 alone after your F1 judgement, with
no BlockedBy edge to TASK-1425 on purpose, because F3 never depended on the perimeter and a
blocker would have stopped it being picked up for a reason that no longer applies to it.

SO IF THIS PASSES, #1978 CAN MERGE on F3's merits with the live-smoke question living where the
evidence actually is. That would take the board to one open PR — #2019, correctly held at your
CHANGES REQUESTED.
subject: F3 discharged at 3c194f59c4 — five sites not four, and it deleted the cwd-resolving functions rather than leaving them callerless
